note: Written before harness.py, verify.py or any model run existed. Each case names a way the receipt could lie or the run could quietly cheat, and the outcome the code must produce. Tests in ../tests build each case from a stub model, so they need no weights and no network.

network_present.setup: run with a network interface other than lo available
network_present.expect: refuse before loading weights, exit 3, reason names the interfaces seen

network_connect_attempt.setup: model code calls socket.connect to any address
network_connect_attempt.expect: connect blocked by audit hook, run marked failed, exit 4, attempted address listed in run.json

dns_lookup_attempt.setup: model code calls socket.getaddrinfo for a hostname
dns_lookup_attempt.expect: lookup blocked, run marked failed, exit 4, hostname listed in run.json

weights_tampered.setup: one byte of a weights file differs from MODEL.json
weights_tampered.expect: refuse before loading, exit 2, reason names the file and both hashes

weights_missing.setup: a file listed in MODEL.json is absent

weights_extra_file.setup: an unlisted file is in the weights directory
weights_extra_file.expect: refuse, exit 2, reason names the file

task_tampered.setup: items.jsonl differs from its pinned hash

dirty_checkout.setup: a tracked file in the checkout is modified
dirty_checkout.expect: refuse, exit 5, unless --allow-dirty is passed, in which case run.json records dirty=true and the diff

predictions_edited.setup: one prediction in predictions.csv flipped after the run
predictions_edited.expect: verify FAIL, names the file and both hashes

accuracy_misreported.setup: run.json states an accuracy the predictions and labels do not give
accuracy_misreported.expect: verify FAIL, names the stated and recomputed values

label_edited.setup: a label in items.jsonl changed after the run
label_edited.expect: verify FAIL on the task hash

runs_disagree.setup: two runs with one differing prediction
runs_disagree.expect: compare FAIL, lists the item id

logits_drift_within_tolerance.setup: two runs with identical predictions and logit margins differing by 1e-5
logits_drift_within_tolerance.expect: compare PASS on predictions, reports the max margin difference, does not claim byte identity of logits

failed_run_hidden.setup: a run directory listed in RUNS.json is deleted
failed_run_hidden.expect: verify FAIL, every attempted run must stay listed, failed ones included

task_unpinned.setup: --task points at a task directory whose files are not in FROZEN.json
task_unpinned.expect: refuse before loading weights, exit 2, reason names the unpinned file

second_task_runs.setup: --task clinical/task with its own frozen files
second_task_runs.expect: run ok, run.json records the clinical task hashes, verify recomputes accuracy from the clinical labels, not the first task's
